title: Time-step invariance of linear shared storage
implementation_note: Each accepted substep is replayed as a fresh one-cell MODFLOW transient solve with its accepted previous head as XOLD/initial head. This isolates timestep partitioning from prepared-solve history.
gates: every substep closes its exact storage balance
all schedules finish at 8.05 m within 1e-10 m
forbidden: do not infer path independence for systems with memory or nonlinear sinks
